newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Movado Group buy affirmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Movado Group buy affirmed.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc affirmed its buy rating on Movado Group Inc Tuesday.
-- Rodman said Movado enjoyed very good holiday retail sell-throughs, especially as its watch brands are targeted at different lifestyles.
-- Rodman said it is comfortable with its earnings estimate for fiscal 1997, which ends January 31, of $1.89 per share. Rodman's earnings estimate for fiscal 1998 remains at $2.20 per share.
-- Movado is a global watch wholesaler.
